internal_wall_spec.method: shared flush wall bands on both floors; fixed stair/basin faces; 900 mm first-floor passage; deeper rebalanced bathrooms
internal_wall_spec.masonry_and_plaster_build_up: Select the masonry unit and plaster coats to total 150 mm; do not add plaster outside this allowance.
internal_wall_spec.wet_finish_note: Bathroom dimensions are to plastered wall faces; final tile build-up requires coordination.

storage_layout.finish: R20: muted natural oak main doors on every bay, creamy matte ivory loft doors and exposed ivory sides, short recessed charcoal edge pulls. Loft tops remain at 2500 mm; space above is open. No cosmetic ceiling band.
storage_layout.doors: Paired narrow hinged leaves: maximum 270 mm leaf width. Corner pair opens without a fixed face post. Supplier to coordinate hinges and access; model shows closed fronts.
storage_layout.beamNote: Loft carcasses stop at 2.50 m, 50 mm below the indicative 2.55 m beam soffit. The space above is open; no cosmetic infill panel, added bulkhead or structural member is introduced. Verify final beam, ceiling, fixing and service positions on site.

units.label: Bedroom 3 L wardrobe + loft
units.cornerNote: Continuous 90 degree L carcass. The short exposed return face is 255 mm wide; hidden corner volume is accessed with both corner leaves open. No solid filler or fixed face post. The full 705 mm footprint length is retained.

units.label: Shared linen / household cabinet
units.interior: Linen shelves in one bay; separate tall bay for slim household tools. Supplier to check equipment width in the reduced bays; keep cleaning products in a separate closed compartment.

beds.type: Closed lift-up storage bases in the existing 2000 x 1500 mm footprints; head hinge on south/x0 end. No side drawers into the compact aisles.
beds.mechanismNote: Volume is the empty panel-lined cavity before lift mechanism, dividers, bedding supports and ventilation allowance; it is not guaranteed usable capacity. Supplier to select rated lift hardware and verify open-lid headboard/window clearance.

capacity.basis: Loft figures are external geometric volume before panels, partitions and hardware. Bed figures are nominal panel-lined cavities before mechanisms/dividers. These figures must not be presented as net usable storage.

storage_layout.constraints: Bedroom cabinet and bed footprints, room directions, windows, bedroom/ensuite doors and gross floor-area totals retained. Study/stair partition removed; shared cabinet moved and reduced to 750 x 450 mm beside the tailoring benches. No overhead cupboards above the bed or across windows/doorways. Upper lofts store occasional-use light items; access with a suitable step stool. Provide ventilation and moisture-resistant detailing to the furniture supplier's specification.

study.retainedStructure: Existing beams, columns, slabs, stair flights and guards retained; partition removal is an architectural proposal requiring structural coordination. The gallery/balcony boundary remains.
study.note: Retain the approved three-machine tailoring function using two compact workbenches. Machine envelopes and seating are illustrative; check actual machines and movement before fabrication. The cabinet is 750 x 450 mm at the west-side edge, leaving the open stair connection clear.
study.benchFinish: muted oak tops on solid oak waterfall end panels; R20 replaces the dark legs
study.chairFinish: solid muted oak chairs with a curved back rail and an oak seat

study_stair_opening.retainedStructure: Existing beams, columns, slabs, stair flights and guards retained; partition removal is an architectural proposal requiring structural coordination. The gallery/balcony boundary remains.
study_stair_opening.note: Retain the approved three-machine tailoring function using two compact workbenches. Machine envelopes and seating are illustrative; check actual machines and movement before fabrication. The cabinet is 750 x 450 mm at the west-side edge, leaving the open stair connection clear.
study_stair_opening.benchFinish: muted oak tops on solid oak waterfall end panels; R20 replaces the dark legs
study_stair_opening.chairFinish: solid muted oak chairs with a curved back rail and an oak seat

opening.note: First-floor stair-side partition removed below the retained beam/soffit band; no floor-level nib or separate pillar. Ground-floor headed TV/basin openings retain their existing heights.

passage.areaBasis: The former 150 mm wall band is reserved for guard/edge details; it is not added to named room clear areas. Gross floor area is unchanged.

guards.finish: Slim charcoal vertical balusters with muted oak top rails, matching the passage reference.

floorEdge.note: Continuous guard beside the actual drop; leave level stair access at y = 2.30-3.20 clear.

upperFlight.note: Additional outer guard follows the first-to-roof return flight; existing inner handrails retained. Coordinate connections where the guard meets the retained overhead support.

first_stair_passage_opening.structure: Existing frame beams, columns, floor/slab opening, waist slabs, landing supports and treads retained. Confirm the partition is non-load-bearing and coordinate the overhead finish/support, guard loads, fixings and rail connections before construction. This is a coordinated concept, not engineered demolition or fabrication detailing.
first_stair_passage_opening.userDecision: Open the first-floor stair-side wall to match the passage photograph; retain the study/gallery weather boundary.

guardReference.basis: Official Kerala rules reference for local professional review. Proposed guard geometry is not a claim of complete current permit compliance.

clear_area_basis: Named clear zones to plastered wall faces; stairs and covered outdoor zones included; removed study/stair partition band included; remaining wall bands/door reveals and the stair guard reserve excluded. Not a statutory carpet-area measurement.

compact_wc_spec.installation_note: Maximum installed projection 550 mm from finished wall; coordinate cistern/carrier within the wall/service construction without taking space from the published clear room. Larger fixtures require a fresh clearance check.

comfort_basis: Compact single-user planning; not universal-access or full NKBA clearance compliance. Fixture selection, tile finish and structural projections need coordination.
vastu_orientation_basis: drawing compass confirmed correct by user; directional room arrangement retained

bedroom1_window_update.scope: User-requested rear opening enlargement; bedroom furniture, room clear dimensions, directions, frame and gross areas retained. Lintel and fixing details require coordination.

roof_access: full south stair from first floor

stair_landing_support.status: Bedroom-door clash correction: the indicative landing support zone previously extended to x = 3.05 and intersected the bedroom entrance at both levels. Its massing now ends at the stair landing edge x = 2.05. This is a conceptual coordination change, not an engineered beam deletion or approval; support, connections and reinforcement remain to be designed. Stair treads, landings, waist slabs, full-height frame beams and floor areas are unchanged.

under_stair_wall_opening.status: Coordinated R10 headed opening, retained through R17; partition widened to 150 mm finished. A full-height removal with no header is not assumed and must not be inferred; it requires separate structural and architectural verification. TO BE DESIGNED / VERIFIED BY STRUCTURAL ENGINEER.

under_stair_washbasin.services: The basin no longer backs onto the bedroom cross-wall, so supply and waste run behind the 30 mm backing panel in the dead zone at x = 0.15-0.69 under the landing and turn into that same y = 6.10 wall at the end of the run - a 0.62 m horizontal leg. TO BE COORDINATED WITH THE PLUMBING DESIGN.

fitout_layout.basis: R20 coordinates the accepted 23 October 2026 interior and exterior presentation images into the drawings and the 3D model. Built-in joinery, fixtures, finishes and fixed exterior elements are carried here and drawn from this file by both. Loose decor shown in the photographs - artwork, rugs, lamps, curtains, plants, cushions, peg rails, shelves and accessories - remains photographic staging and is not scheduled. Room footprints, walls, openings, stairs, frame and gross areas are unchanged.

exterior.timberNote: One warm natural honey-oak / light teak tone for every exterior timber surface: cladding, soffits, parapet bands and the roof stair enclosure. Measured from the accepted entrance photograph (saturation about 0.35). Not grey or taupe, not orange or glossy. Supplier sample to be approved against the photograph.
exterior.frontDoorNote: Front door in the same muted natural oak as the cladding, with a black handle.
exterior.pavingNote: Warm grey-beige pavers to the drive, paths and front yard, harmonising with the sandy entrance steps.
exterior.seating: Woven-cane muted-oak armchairs with oatmeal cushions at the front sit-out and the front balcony.

rearScreen.finish: vertical aluminium louvres, oak-tone wood-grain powder coat
rearScreen.note: R20 replaces the solid first-floor north privacy screen at the end of the rear drying balcony with ventilated vertical louvres from floor to the timber soffit. It screens the drying zone from the north side while keeping airflow. The long rear railing stays open. Fixings to the C5/C6 column zones and the slab edge TO BE DESIGNED.

uppers.finish: muted natural oak flat doors matching the base units, recessed charcoal pulls
uppers.light: warm concealed strip under the north uppers

lofts.note: Continuous loft row around the upper perimeter, bridging the east window above its +2.15 m head and continuing over the fridge housing. Tops at +2.50 m, 50 mm under the indicative beam soffit.

pantry.finish: muted oak tall doors, recessed charcoal pulls, plinth matching the base units
pantry.note: Shallow 350 mm full-height pantry on the south end wall between the counter return and the fridge housing. Its face at x = 0.50 stays 0.20 m short of the hob.

fridgeHousing.finish: flush muted oak side panels to the loft above
fridgeHousing.note: Freestanding fridge enclosed in oak side panels. Clear niche about 0.61 m wide; select a fridge no wider than 0.60 m and keep the manufacturer's ventilation gaps.

hood.note: Over the existing two-burner hob in front of the east window, rising into the loft bridge above the window head. Extract duct route through the external wall above the lintel TO BE COORDINATED.

kitchen.excluded: The washable cotton runner, plants and accessories are staging.

pendant.type: woven natural-cane globe pendant, warm 2700 K lamp

dining.finish: muted oak 1.20 x 0.75 m table; two light-oak wishbone chairs with woven paper-cord seats on the room side; oak bench with oatmeal cushion tucked under the window side; woven cane globe pendant centred over the table (25 Oct 2026, from the accepted dining photograph)
dining.note: Replaces the round table and three chairs. The table ends at y = 5.25, leaving 0.85 m clear to the rear service route at y = 6.10, and the room-side chairs keep x = 3.25-4.11 open for the front-door route.

living.lighting: Evening scheme from the accepted 02-living-evening image: dimmable dining pendant, the TV-plinth strip and basin wall light on their own switches, and a switched socket in the window corner for the floor lamp. Ceiling downlights are a separate circuit so they can stay off. The mushroom lamps are cordless and rechargeable; no wiring. Electrical layout to be coordinated.
living.staging: Cushions, throw, walnut stool, mushroom lamps, vases, mirrors and the kitchen canister shelf in the 25 Oct images are loose decor and are not scheduled.
living.note: Coffee table 0.40 m in front of the sofa; 0.72 m walkway kept beside it.

bathrooms.vanity: wall-hung oak vanity with two drawers, pale stone counter and slim rectangular under-counter basin, within the published basin footprint
bathrooms.mirror: mirror-fronted wall cabinet over the basin with a concealed warm light beneath

niche.note: Top at +1.10 m, below the +1.20 m sill of the Ensuite 1 rear window; the first-floor vents sit higher.

bathrooms.drain: slim linear drain along the shower
bathrooms.floorNote: Matte large-format pale sandy stone floor tiles replace the small mosaic.
bathrooms.excluded: Waffle bath mats, towels and refillable dispensers are staging.

pergola.finish: matte charcoal steel frame with rolled natural bamboo chick blinds over the purlins
pergola.note: Open shade structure on four posts set over the B4, B5, C4 and C5 column zones. It is not a roof or an enclosed room, and is not added to the floor area; confirm whether local rules count it as covered area. Post bases, wind uplift anchorage and waterproofing at the slab fixings TO BE DESIGNED / VERIFIED BY STRUCTURAL ENGINEER.

bench.finish: rendered masonry bench in ivory with outdoor seat cushions
bench.note: Built against the north parapet. A seat is a foothold, so the guard is raised to 1.10 m above the seat (+1.55 m above the roof finish) for the bench length plus 0.10 m each end. Bench load on the roof slab beside the C-line edge beam to be verified.

terrace.excluded: The outdoor rug and festoon lights are staging; any lighting is an outdoor-rated electrical installation.
